name: Farliuzco
backstory: Child of Tamuzco and Farliazco, in Terfila; grew up around haggles for cart space at the market before..., and picked up a little of Birth Of Nakoran along the way.

Grew up hearing: Learned that Trezco has died.

Grew up hearing: Had a child with Forliauzco, named Forliuzazco.

criterion.standard: measures a life by whether Birth Of Nierius is still remembered rightly
criterion.wasted_life: forgetting what Birth Of Nierius actually meant, the way most people already have
criterion.trusts: a story that's been carried and retold and still holds together
criterion.distrusts: a record that insists on a precision no one who was actually there ever needed

routines.routine_actions: makes the walk between Terfila and the crossing when there's nothing better to do at the docks, and lingers by the temple a beat longer than the walk requires.

arc.premise: Farliuzco wants to know whether Gorff's control of the tollhouse was ever actually legitimate or just never challenged - he means to find whatever record exists of how it was first granted, if any does.
